main_text.p: נָזַז Resecuit, Abscidit, Totondit: Part. כִּי נָזַז Quòd tonderet, 1.Sam.25.4. Plur. נָזִים Tondentes, 2.Sam. 13.23. Constr. עַל נָזֵּי Ad tonsores, Genes.38.12. Niph. Præter. נִנְזוּ Tonsi fuissent, Nah.1.12.

נֹז m. Vellus, Secta lana, Deuter.18.4. וּמִנָּזּ Et de vellere, Job.31. v.20. Item, Secta herba, Psalm.72.6. Plural. Constr. נְזֵי Fænisecia, Amos 7.1. Fœmin. נִזָּה Vellus, Jud.6.37. Constr. נִזַּת הַצֶּמֶר Vellus lanæ, ibid.

נְזִית f. Cæsura, Cæsio: Lapis cælus & ferro politus, 1.Keg.5.17. Sic Kimchi illud hûc refert, quasi pro נְזִית positû, ut dicitur זְלוֹת a זלל. Alioqui magis esset a נז deducendum. Kimchi in Michlol scribit, esse pro נְזִּיִּית forme נִפְרִית. Sic vult etiam בְּרִית esse pro בְּרִרִית, & contractum debuisse dagessari, נְזִית. Sed בְּרִית cū Cholem loco Dagesch.
נָזַל Rapuit, Abripuit, Diripuit: Præterit. גְּזֻלוֹת נָזַל Rapinas rapuit, Ezech.18.12. Niph.Præter. וְנִגְזְלָה Et eripitur, Prov.4.16.
גֵּזֶל m. Idem: וּגְזֵל מִשְׁפָּט Et rapina juris, Eccles.5.7.
גּוְזָל m. Pullus, avium vel columbarum proprie, quod Rapinæ sit expositus, Genes.15. v.9. Plural. cum Aff. גּוְזָלָיו Pullos suos, Deut.32.11.
גְּזֵלָה fœm. Raptum, Rapina, Levit.6.4. Construct. גְּזֵלַת הָעָנִי Rapina pauperis, Jesa.3.14. Plural. גְּזֵלוֹת Ezech.18.12.
גֵּזָם m. Eruca, Joel.1.4. Aben Esra à גָּזַז Tondendo, deducit, & מ servile esse vult.
גִּזַע m. Truncus succisus, Jesa.11.1. Aff. גִּזְעוֹ Truncus succisus ejus, Job.14.8.
גָּזַר Secuit, Scidit, Abscidit: Decidit, Decrevit: Præt. גָּזַר Abscinderet, scil. hostis, vel Abscinderetur, Hab.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some word forms are small and blurred; forms marked nowhere are copied as best read, and the pointing in several Hebrew words (e.g. Constr. entries, Aff. forms, the Plural of entry 9) may not match the print exactly. "Resecuit" is read with a long s (printed form looks like "Refecuit"). Biblical references are copied as printed (e.g. "1.Keg.5.17", "Genes.38.12"). The line "Hab." stands flush right after the last entry and is kept as part of it.
